purpose: Learner-first musical calibration from owner listening sessions
principles: Prefer a recognizable, playable arrangement over literal source fidelity.
Keep the melody predominantly in the right hand.
Use the left hand for useful bass notes and proper piano chord shapes.
Treat structural validation as necessary but not sufficient for musical quality.
